description: Reference mock model outputs for offline B-module tests. Each case is a canned LLM suggestion (the same shape the model is prompted to return: {events:[], unmerged_evidence_ids:[]}) used to exercise the deterministic validator without a real model. Evidence IDs are examples against a run_id of 'mockrun'.

legal_grouping.description: A valid two-ticker event whose evidence IDs belong to the run and match the records.

events.summary: Apple and Microsoft announce AI chip partnership

single_ticker.description: An event backed by a single distinct ticker; the validator must degrade it to unmerged.

no_events.description: Records exist but the model found no cross-ticker common event.

forged_id.description: One event mixes a valid evidence ID with a forged one; the forged ID must be dropped.

events.summary: event with a forged evidence id

cross_run_id.description: An evidence ID issued by a different run; the validator must reject it as non-resolvable.

events.summary: event with a cross-run evidence id

mismatched_ticker.description: A claim whose ticker disagrees with the authoritative record; the claim is dropped.
